summary: # Introduction to the New Features of Marvelous Designer 2025.1 - Denim Wash Effect ## Overview of the Cow Dung Water Washing Effect Creating the cow dung water washing effect has always been a very complicated process. However, with our new design, you can achieve this effect faster and more easily. ## Activating the Water Washing Effect To turn on the water washing effect, please first select the fabric to which you wish to apply the effect. Then, under the type selection, switch the fabric from **matte** to **cow dung**. ### Default Settings Under the default setting, it is set to **non-water washing**. However, you can choose any water washing type and start to define your own parameters. In this example, I will choose **acid washing**. As you can see, the water washing effect has been successfully applied. ## Adjusting the Water Washing Parameters Now we can use some parameters to adjust the results: ### Acid Concentration The first parameter is **acid concentration**. This is the only setting that changes according to the water washing type. It controls the strength or opacity of the water washing sticker. ### Mixing Mode You can also adjust the **mixing mode**. Here, I choose the **stacking mode**. The absorption increases the blur or spread effect for the sticker, mimicking the way the water wash is absorbed into the plant. ### Cycle Cycle The **cycle cycle** can increase the brightness of the water wash. The longer the water wash cycle is imitated, the brighter the surface effect obtained. ### Strengthening Wrinkle Texture Finally, the cow dung can strengthen the wrinkle texture of the clothes. You can experiment with this effect until you achieve the desired appearance. ## Final Adjustments Click on the **water washing technique type** and **water washing pattern**. You can set the **shrink**, **rotate**, and **balance** of the water washing pattern. Specific values can be entered here to complete the adjustment. ### Switching Water Washing Types As mentioned above, if you switch to a different water washing type, you will see that the acid concentration has become another setting. They have similar functions, allowing you to set other water washing settings to increase the authenticity of your work. ## Conclusion That's all for this video. See you in the next video.
